name: Custom Block With Termination
hint: If a custom block contains a [sbi]stop [all v][/sbi] or [sbi]delete this clone[/sbi] and the custom block is called in the middle of another script, the script will never reach the blocks following the call.
instruction: If a custom block contains a [sbi]stop [all v][/sbi] or [sbi]delete this clone[/sbi] and the custom block is called in the middle of another script, the script will never reach the blocks following the call.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
define walkSquare
repeat (4)
move (10) steps
turn left (90) degrees
end
stop [all v] :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛

when green flag clicked
walkSquare
say [finished] for (2) seconds //⇦  🐛

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
define walkSquare
repeat (4)
move (10) steps
turn left (90) degrees
end

when green flag clicked
walkSquare
say [finished]for (2) seconds
stop [all v] :: #007000 //⇦  👍
